tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Alternating full-width and reading-width modules. Reusable modules support several kinds of public communication.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts are stored or specified as destination assets.
tokens.role: Use distinct display, reading, and utility voices. Brand character survives without one rigid page template.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: Color roles are analytical; preview colors are original and non-exact.
tokens.role: Long reading, campaigns, and product explanation share compatible foundations.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.notes: Behavioral priority must be revalidated in the destination product.
tokens.role: Design guidance and front-end components are presented as one working system.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Modular editorial bands with bold type, one campaign color, and a bounded media feature. Use separate product, photography, illustration, and data roles.
